title: Team API key (e2b_): one-property twin (length)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: a 39-byte body vs exactly 40 and length: a 41-byte body vs exactly 40. Twin of "Team API key (e2b_): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of e2b-api-key-dotenv: length: a 39-byte body vs exactly 40. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
